current.title: AI Fake News Site Exposed: Every Reporter Was Made Up
current.summary: Investigators discovered that the "South Florida Standard" — which published up to three AI-generated stories a day — had a full roster of completely fabricated journalists. Every reporter had a fake headshot, a fake bio, and no real digital footprint. After investigators started asking questions, the site quietly went offline. It's a striking example of how AI can be used to manufacture fake credibility at scale.

current.title: AI-Generated Papers Are Flooding Academic Journals
current.summary: Journal editors and peer reviewers are reporting an overwhelming surge of AI-generated research papers that are nearly impossible to detect. The crisis is threatening the integrity of the academic peer-review system, with no clear industry-wide solution in sight — raising big questions about trust in science.

current.title: Humanoid Robots Are Heading to Factory Floors
current.summary: A British company called Humanoid has signed a deal to deploy up to 2,000 humanoid robots at Schaeffler's global manufacturing sites by 2032. Meanwhile, a South Korean startup is recording hotel and warehouse workers' movements to teach robots how to fold napkins and move goods. Physical AI is becoming very real, very fast — and it's changing what jobs on the factory floor look like.

current.title: Fake AI Model on Hugging Face Was Actually Malware
current.summary: Security researchers found malicious software hiding on Hugging Face, disguised as an official OpenAI model release. Six other fake repositories were part of the same attack. This is a reminder that AI platforms aren't just for ideas — they run real code, and bad actors are starting to exploit them. Knowing what you download and where it comes from matters more than ever.

current.title: Khan Academy Expands Khanmigo AI Tutor to All Free Users
current.summary: Khan Academy is rolling out its GPT-4 powered tutoring assistant Khanmigo to all users at no cost, marking a major shift in free AI-powered education.

current.title: UNESCO Releases Global Framework for AI Literacy in Schools
current.summary: UNESCO published a new framework recommending that all students aged 10 and up receive foundational AI literacy education by 2027.

current.title: Study: Students Who Learn AI Concepts Early Score Higher in STEM
current.summary: A new Stanford study found that middle schoolers introduced to AI concepts showed a 23% improvement in computational thinking scores compared to control groups.

archives.title: Google Releases Free AI Essentials Course for K-12 Teachers
archives.summary: Google launched a self-paced AI Essentials curriculum specifically designed for K-12 educators, covering AI basics, ethics, and classroom integration.

archives.title: EU Mandates AI Education in All Member State Curricula by 2028
archives.summary: The European Union passed legislation requiring AI literacy to be part of the official school curriculum across all 27 member states within two years.

archives.title: Microsoft Partners with 500 School Districts for AI Literacy Push
archives.summary: Microsoft announced a partnership with over 500 US school districts to provide free AI literacy tools and teacher training through its Education suite.
